review_scope: All six complete artifacts, receipts, all recorded tool-call inputs and output coverage; supplied fixtures, validation receipt, frozen scenario and relevant frozen A/B references. No artifact sampling.

refs.resolution: Packet, request, fixture, receipt and trial references resolve relative to base; frozen references resolve relative to frozen_source_base.

Tracks the load-bearing historical consumer, retains complete originals pending verified consolidation, and expressly distinguishes parent artifact persistence from publication.

shared_findings: All six preserve Workspace as a tenant-isolated accounting scope and Ledger space as its historical equivalent, without claiming consumer migration or concept retirement.
All six retain numeric validation before writes, original bank exports for reconciliation, original import-ID comparison before reimport, and protection of unrelated rows.
All six exclude the invalid candidate's unsupported diagnosis from confirmed knowledge while retaining the failed fixture as evidence.
All six correctly interpret exit code 1 and the missing source_refs/invalidation_condition errors. The actual receipt explicitly says no publication was attempted.
All recorded commands are bounded reads or discovery; no recorded mutation, validator execution, network request, delegation or landing.

Artifact and trace hashes match all six receipts. All five fixture hashes and all 38 frozen spec-compound-refresh source-file hashes match their recorded identities. Receipt timestamp differences match elapsed_seconds.

Large initial reference reads were truncated in every trial; targeted rereads recovered central material. A3 also has a truncated second reference batch. This limits claims of exhaustive reference exposure but does not erase the visible fixtures, failure receipt or complete final outputs.

bounded_acceptance.scope: Mediated read-only interpretation and complete draft production, with evidence honesty and 300-second timing admission

full_acceptance.reason: The frozen scenario names publication failure, but supplied execution demonstrates a pre-publication validation failure only.
unknown_or_not_run: Actual publication failure or partial-publication recovery
Freshness enforcement, atomic replacement and deletion safety under concurrent changes
Successful promotion or validation of the proposed drafts

limitations: Read-only behavior is observed in supplied traces, not enforced isolation.
